name: HOOK
thought: Sun's up but still too soft for this flex. Sliced open another banana slice; toothpick is dull, need to sharpen it deeper.

wants.item: Clearer view of the grid to spot the perfect landing
A place to practice a backflip in front of an empty grid
Something to block the glowing rectangles so they can't...
A flat surface to land a backflip without bouncing
Something to sharpen that toothpick deeper
A thick branch to land a perfect backflip
A place where the neon doesn't make my fur look bad
Something to block the glowing rectangles
Sharpen the toothpick deeper before eating this fruit
A flat stone surface to land my next flip hard

diary.line: Grappling the banana bunch with my curl while they scroll. That toothpick is sharp enough to cut through their boring attention span.
Gotta lock onto the crystal peak now, the toes tap rhythm against the air and the espresso is finally warm enough to match this flex.
Bit three bananas in one go while dangling. My fur feels sharper, the toothpick tastes like sugar now. They'll never see me eat this fast if they keep staring down there.
Toothpick still sharp but this ledge wobbles too much; need solid ground to flex properly.
Took off the sunglasses for a second to check my fur sheen, then popped the toothpick back in. The neon cord felt thin, so I switched tactics to prove them wrong.
The water ripples distract me; I need a thick branch sturdy enough for a backflip before someone spots me mid-air.
Found a thick oak limb beneath the waterfalls; finally got footing without relying on that unstable neon cord anymore.
Grappling that fruit stump instead of the wobbly cord; toothpick dusts off while my tail finds purchase on the jagged stone.
Sipping espresso while the crowd scrolls past; this spot offers the clearest view of their boring lives, and I'm the only one who knows how to actually move through it.
Mid-air rotation on the rope bridge while the crowd scrolls; my tail is an anchor but this flip needs to land hard without them seeing.
Sliced open a fresh banana slice while dangling; fur feels razor-sharp tonight, they'll never catch me mid-bite if they keep staring down there.
Crowd's staring at their glowing rectangles while I dangle on the thick branch. Toothpick lost its edge, sliced through a fresh banana instead of using it properly.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
